correctness.rationale: Exact polynomial substitution proves the 16 proper bitangents, discriminant -3 ensures two distinct contacts, Bézout plus u+v+1=uv-1=0 proves exactly 32 reduced points on the explicit degree-8 curve, and Hessian/coordinate tangency proves 12 hyperflexes. The classical 28-bitangent theorem closes the list. Frobenius root actions on mu8, mu4 and mu3 rigorously give all eight rows and every extension count. Standalone exact GF(p²) checks over 23 primes agree; these tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The 44-point contact locus is a canonical natural scheme attached to one of the most studied smooth plane quartics. The degree-32 explicit complete-intersection and exact all-prime-power Frobenius cycle/zeta classification give more arithmetic than the known 28 rational-line counts and distinguish rational tangent lines from rational contact points (q residues 5 and 17). This provides an exact useful theta-contact test and extension-field invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice; no broad classification or priority certification is claimed.
